title: Veeam security advisory (AV26-1096)
description: As of October 27, 2026, Veeam is affected by vulnerabilities in the following products:
products:
Veeam Agent for Linux
	Prior to 13.1.2

Veeam Backup and Replication
	Prior to 13.0.3
Prior to 13.1.2

Veeam Backup for Microsoft 365
	Prior to or equal to 8.5.0.1014
Prior to or equal to 8.6.0.1102

Veeam ONE
	Prior to or equal to 13.1.0.7233
solution: Review the references and apply the necessary updates.
